method.method_draft: First inspect the image: the three shown patterns have central gray squares of size 1×1, 2×2, and 3×3, with white square tiles around them in the same outline shape. Count the white tiles in each shown pattern by rows. Pattern 1 has row counts 3, 5, 4, 5, 3 for a total of 20 white tiles. Pattern 2 has 28 white tiles. Pattern 3 has 36 white tiles. The counts increase by 8 each time, so treat the tile counts as an arithmetic sequence with first term 20 and common difference 8. The tenth pattern needs 20 + 9×8 = 92 tiles.
